name: Mark Messmer
bio: a Representative from Indiana; born September 1962; graduated from Jasper High School, Jasper, Ind., 1981; B.S., Purdue University, West Lafayette, Ind., 1985; engineer; business owner; member of the Indiana state house of representatives, 2008-2014; member of the Indiana state senate, 2014-2024; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
